AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
April 22, 2020
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.
CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY
Due to the state and local State of Emergency resulting from the threat of Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19), Governor Newsom has issued Executive Order N-29-20 in which Section 3 supersedes Paragraph 11 of Executive Order N-25-20 (issued on March 12, 2020) addressing Brown Act regulations. This new order states that the City does not need to make a physical location available for members of the public to observe a public meeting and offer public comment. The Order allows the City to hold City Council/Board meetings via teleconferencing and allows for members of the public to observe and address the meeting telephonically or electronically.
To follow the new Order issued by the Governor, the Planning Commission meeting scheduled for Wednesday, April 22, 2020 at 7:00 p.m. will be closed to the public. Members of the public may submit Public Comments by 7:00 p.m. electronically only by emailing PublicComment@azusaca.gov. Emailed public comments will be sent to all Planning Commission Members and will be part of the record. (Comments shall be limited to no more than 250 words). View the Planning Commission meeting live at the City's website https://www.ci.azusa.ca.us/1389/Watch-Meetings-Online, or Channel 3 (Spectrum).

Case No.: Code Amendment No. 247 Location: City of Azusa
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa is proposing a Code Amendment to amend Section 88.42.190 of the City’s Municipal Code relating to accessory dwelling units (ADUs). The proposed changes will bring Azusa’s ADU ordinance consistent with state law.
The proposal is exempt from environmental review because the proposed action is not considered a “project,” per Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines.

Case No.: Code Amendment No. 248 Location: City of Azusa
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa is proposing a Code Amendment to introduce a new Section (88.51.034) of the City’s Municipal Code to allow for a Discretional ADU Permit process for new ADUs that do not conform to the objective standards set forth in Section 88.42.190 of AMC.
The proposal is exempt from environmental review because the proposed action is not considered a “project,” per Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines.
